limits: Only selected registered cells in this 60-um Layer-IV microdomain carry surface morphology.
BLOOD_VESSEL_CELL is vascular-associated and is not asserted to be a pericyte.
MG_OPC is retained as the combined class supplied by H01; it is not split into microglia versus OPC.
Every cell surface is deterministically clipped from its released LOD-3 mesh and, when above its browser budget, quadric-decimated; it preserves gross morphology, not ultrastructural detail.
The astrocyte has the largest cell triangle budget, but remains a local crop rather than the complete arbor beyond the inset bounds.
The vascular-associated-cell surface preserves the released crop's gross form after browser-safe decimation; H01 does not identify it as a specific mural subtype.
The inhibitory surface is H01 c3 segment 40944243140; its Layer-IV soma lies 11.302 um outside the unchanged crop, and only released triangles entering the crop are retained.
A 3.262-um capillary surface discontinuity at the acquisition boundary is closed with an explicitly marked display-only bridge supported by aligned repaired-centreline endpoints.
The complete inset is deliberately constrained to a presentation-safe triangle budget so it can animate on an integrated GPU.

microdomain.limits: Most classes remain registered somata; selected local neurons, one astrocyte, one vascular-associated cell, and the capillary carry released surface topology.
